name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Samsung36
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sends a Samsung36 infrared remote code to a remote transmitter. It transmits the `address` and `command` in two packets separated by a "space".

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The address to send, see dumper output for more details.

config_entries.label: Command
config_entries.description: The Samsung36 command to send, see dumper output for more details.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.
